g.text: GOOSE protocol is configured by loading the SCL file. The parser parses the file and extracts the GOOSE data
and updates the comboboxes of Publisher/Subscriber component.
Once the SCL is loaded, you can choose which IED and GOOSE messages you want to Send/Receive.
The data preview can be inspected by clicking the Data preview button inside the dialog window once
The input/output of Publisher/Subscriber components are vectorised, and the size of each veactor is
dictated by the data of the message.
